title: Immigrant Affairs & Austin Energy's Future
summary:
*   **Immigrant Rights & Community Support:** The Commission on Immigrant Affairs updated on their goals, an upcoming recognition event, and support for state House Bill 57.
*   **Austin Energy's Financial Future:** Austin Energy presented an overview of its debt planning and financial strategy.
*   **Confidential Energy Strategy:** A closed-door session discussed sensitive generation and financial planning issues for Austin Energy.
transcript:
CITY COUNCIL WORKSESSION 
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26,2003
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORK SESSION
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26,2003
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they
occurred during the meeting.
The City Council of Austin, Texas convened in a Work Session on Wednesday, March 26,
2003 at One Texas Center, 505 Barton Springs Road, 3rd Floor Training Room, Austin,
Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 10:07 a.m.
BRIEFINGS
2. 
Update by the Commission on Immigrant Affairs on their goals and accomplishments
including upcoming Immigrant Recognition Event and the support of House Bill 57.
Luis Plascencia, Chair of the Commission on Immigrant Affairs; and Snahal Patel,
Julien Ross, and Leo Anchondo, Commissioners; and Austin Dullnig, Human Rights
Commissioner, made the presentation.
3. 
Update on debt planning by Austin Energy.
The presentation was made by Juan Garza, General Manager, and Elaine
Kuhlman, Vice President of Finance, of Austin Energy.
Mayor Garcia recessed the Work Session at 11:30 a.m. to go into the Executive Session.
EXECUTIVE SESSION
Public Power Utility Competitive Matters - Section 551.086
1. 
Discuss generation planning and financial planning issues for Austin Energy.
Executive Session ended at 12:30 a.m.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 12:33 a.m. was approved on Council Member
Slusher's motion, Council Member Alvarez' second on a 4-0 vote. Mayor Garcia and
Council Member Wynn were off the dais. Council Member Thomas was absent.
CITY COUNCIL WORKSESSION 
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26,2003
The minutes for the worksession of March 26, 2003 were approved on April 3, 2003 on
Mayor Pro Tern Goodman's motion, Council Member Dunkerley's second on a 7-0 vote.
